newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS cuts cash bond rates.
newsitem.headline: UBS cuts cash bond rates.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) said it was lowering the rates it pays on two- through eight-year cash bonds (kassenobligationen), effective September 27.
The rate on two-year bonds was lowered to 2.0 percent from 2-1/2, the three-year rate to 2-1/2 from 3.0 percent, four-year bonds to 3.0 from 3-1/4 and five-year bonds to 3-1/4 from 3-1/2.
Six- seven- and eight-year bond rates were cut by one quarter percentage point each to 3-1/2, 3-3/4 and 4.0 percent, respectively.
Cash bonds, fixed-rate deposits for small investors, are used by banks to help finance their mortgage lending. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
